title: Here Are the Best Apple Black Friday Leftover Deals You Can Get Today
content:
Black Friday has ended, but Amazon and other retailers have kept the discounts flowing into today. We're still tracking all of the best Black Friday prices on a big collection of Apple products below.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

AirPods



  • What's the deal? Get $100 off AirPods Pro 3

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find more AirPods deals? Right here

$100 OFF
AirPods Pro 3 for $149.00


The number one Black Friday 2026 deal is still up for grabs today: you can get the AirPods Pro 3 for $149.00 on Amazon, down from $249.00. That's a massive $100 in savings and still an all-time low price.

MacBook



  • What's the deal? Get up to $399 off M5 MacBook Air

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find more MacBook deals? Right here

$299 OFF
13-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB/512GB) for $999.99

$399 OFF
13-inch M5 MacBook Air (24GB/1TB) for $1,399.99


MacBook deals remain some of the best and steepest markdowns available this season, and all of the best Black Friday deals remain available on every M5 MacBook Air model. If you check out our Mac-specific Black Friday post, you'll find all-time lows on M6 MacBook Pro and PROLED MacBook Pro as well.

Apple Watch



  • What's the deal? Get $100 off Apple Watch Series 12

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find more Apple Watch deals? Right here

$100 OFF
Apple Watch Series 12 (42mm GPS) for $299.00

$100 OFF
Apple Watch Series 12 (46mm GPS) for $349.00


The best Apple Watch deals of the season are still available today, with Apple Watch Series 12 starting at $299.00 ($100 off) and Apple Watch SE 3 starting at $179.00 ($70 off).

iPad



  • What's the deal? Get $100 off iPad mini 8

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find more iPad deals? Right here

$100 OFF
iPad mini 8 (128GB Wi-Fi) for $599.00


Amazon's $100 discount on the new iPad mini 8 remains up for sale today, so you can get the 128GB Wi-Fi model for $599.00, down from $699.00.

AirTag



  • What's the deal? Get $11 off AirTag 2

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find more AirTag deals? Right here

$11 OFF
AirTag 2 for $18.00


The AirTag 2 1-Pack is still on sale for the low price of $18.00 today, down from $29.00. Deals on the 4-Pack never reached all-time low prices yesterday, but this is a great record low on the 1-Pack.

iPhone



  • What's the deal? Get up to $2,100 off iPhone Duo and up to $1,400 off iPhone 18 Pro

  • Where can I get it? T-Mobile

  • Where can I find more iPhone deals? Right here

UP TO $1,400 OFF
iPhone 18 Pro at T-Mobile

UP TO $2,100 OFF
iPhone Duo at T-Mobile


To shop the best iPhone deals still around, you'll need to head to a cellular carrier like T-Mobile. There you'll find as much as $2,100 off Apple's iPhone Duo on the new T-Mix plans. There are plenty of rules and catches to cellular offers, so be sure to read our post on Black Friday iPhone deals for the full details.

If you're on the hunt for more discounts, be sure to visit our Apple Deals roundup where we recap the best Apple-related bargains of the past week.
